from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background)
    marker = nonbg.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The embedded three-cell line is the template; the most common
    # non-background singleton color marks where copies belong.
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            vals = [grid[r][c+i] for i in range(3)]
            if all(v != background and v != marker for v in vals):
                candidates.append(([(r,c+i) for i in range(3)], vals))
    for r in range(h - 2):
        for c in range(w):
            vals = [grid[r+i][c] for i in range(3)]
            if all(v != background and v != marker for v in vals):
                candidates.append(([(r+i,c) for i in range(3)], vals))
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Prefer the most isolated/compact template detected in the input.
    cells, vals = candidates[0]
    dr = cells[1][0] - cells[0][0]
    dc = cells[1][1] - cells[0][1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == marker:
                for k, value in enumerate(vals):
                    rr = r + (k-1)*dr
                    cc = c + (k-1)*dc
                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                        out[rr][cc] = value
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-d8e2d3cf.py'
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
